info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector PurviewPolicies API
Microsoft Azure Api To List The Purview Rbac Policies Based On A Scope

params.name: skipToken
params.description: Paging key to paginate to next page.

params.name: $filter
params.description: Supported filters : $filter=policyType eq SelfService, $filter=policyType eq SqlDevops. Returns only the policies of the specified type. If not specified, all policies are returned.

items.docs: The API lists the Azure purview RBAC policies affecting the scope. The scope can be any valid ARM resource id
